spec.direction: LONG only (the short side PAYS the premium: negative in 18/18 tested cells)
spec.entry: close of the 1-second bar at (release_time - 300s); reject if that bar is >60s away

take_profit.fill: resting limit: better of (line, bar open)

spec.tie_rule: one 1-second bar breaching BOTH stop and TP counts as a STOP (pessimistic)
spec.timed_exit: close of the bar at (release_time + 900s) for any open position
spec.qty: integer >= 1; dollars scale linearly (verified 327/327 events to the cent at qty=3); pnl_points stay per-contract
spec.series_note: CPI is the engine in every measurement method; selection from the M2 power model (trailing-24)

risk_facts.payoff_shape: long-volatility: most events lose ~-1R; the ~1/3 that hit +4R pay for everything (2024+ NQ: median -$363, p95 +$2,071)
risk_facts.worst_measured_slippage: a stop fill at 2.1x the nominal stop distance (gap-through-stop in the sweep second)
risk_facts.blind_spot: fills assume line-or-open on 1-second bars; sweep-second slippage beyond the stressed 4 ticks is unmeasurable in bar data
risk_facts.era_dependence: the premium was ~0 before 2020; strongest 2025-2026; nothing in-sample separates permanent premium from inflation-era regime

operations.regime_monitor: rolling mean of the last 24 CPI-event P&Ls < $0 => STAND_DOWN (sticky; clearing is an owner action). Run src/deploy/regime_monitor.py.
operations.annual_check: re-run the claims ledger (optimize/verify/run.py on the research branch); if not green, published numbers have drifted
